artworks.title: Nile Journey, Feluccas (recto)
artworks.artist: Elihu Vedder
artworks.medium: colored chalk on blue paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Richard Spear and Athena Tacha
artworks.description: The image shows sketches of boats and sails on a blue-grey background. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, capturing three sailboats from different angles. One sailboat is close to us on the lower right, with its sails filled by the wind, sailing across calm waters. In the distance, another ship with tucked sails is seen alongside a faint land outline at the horizon line. A smaller sketch of a sailboat is on the left, providing a detailed perspective of the sail and rigging. The brushstrokes and pencil lines are delicate and sketchy, applied lightly to evoke the scene's simplicity. The color palette is muted, with shades of grey, white, and hints of red and brown. The artist's signature and the year, 1890, are inscribed below the boat on the right.

artworks.title: Nile Journey, Colossi of Memnon
artworks.artist: Elihu Vedder
artworks.medium: colored chalk on blue wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Richard Spear and Athena Tacha
artworks.description: This image shows a landscape with a serene ambiance. Rolling hills meet the sky at the horizon, stretching to the left. Two tall structures are visible in the distance. The foreground features green terrain with grassy textures. The painting has soft brushstrokes and a calming appearance. The color scheme is cool, with shades of green, beige, and a pale, grayish-blue sky dominating the composition.

artworks.title: Nile Journey, Manfalout, Through Spyglass
artworks.artist: Elihu Vedder
artworks.medium: colored chalk on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Richard Spear and Athena Tacha
artworks.description: The image shows a small tower in a sketched landscape with sparse trees. The tower has two tiers with arched openings and a pointed finial. The trees have slender trunks and leafless branches. The sky is light in color. The terrain seems to slope gently. The artwork uses soft brushstrokes and muted tones of gray, blue, and brown on beige paper. The composition is asymmetrical, with the focus on the tower and its surroundings.

artworks.title: View of an Ancient Roman Bridge with a Mascaroon
artworks.artist: Victor Jean Nicolle
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray, dark gray, and brown wash, with touches of white gouache,  on laid paper, laid down on an old mount
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Vincent J. Buonanno
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with an elevated point of view looking down at an architectural setting dominated by a large arched entrance. A wall rises up behind the entrance, leading to a building and tall trees in the distance. The building has a classical style with many windows and is on top of a structure resembling a cliff or fortified wall with climbing plants. The color palette includes muted browns, grays, and earthy tones. Brushstrokes create texture and detail like stonework and foliage. Closest to us, a few figures are gathered near a ledge, and one person walks into the dark archway.

artworks.title: A  Woman Wearing a Straw Hat [Madame de Pompadour?]

artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper [proof]
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ivan E. and Winifred Phillips in honor of Jonathan Bober
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person from the chest upwards. The individual is facing slightly to their left, with a direct gaze towards the viewer. Their facial features include arched eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes, a straight nose, and lips that appear to have a subtle smile. The hair is light in color, styled back and adorned with a flower on the left side of their head. The person is wearing a dress with a low neckline, trimmed with intricate lace. On the left shoulder, there appear to be decorative flowers. The background is a uniform, darkened tone that emphasizes the subject’s features and attire.

artworks.description: The image depicts an upper-body sketch of a person facing to the right in profile. The person has their hands clasped together in front of them. The individual's face shows a sloping forehead, a straight nose, and slightly pursed lips. Their hair is styled back neatly with loose curls at the back, and they are wearing a garment with puffed sleeves and a wide neckline. There is no visible jewelry, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: Concarneau Terrace / Brittany Street Scene
artworks.artist: Robert Henri
artworks.medium: black ink on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William and Abigail Gerdts
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene from an elevated perspective, with figures walking along a busy pathway. Women in long dresses and hats are close by, and in the distance, there are tall ship masts. The horizon is high up in the composition, with faint outlines of trees and structures against the sky. The painting uses loose, sketchy brushstrokes with black ink on a light background, creating a monochromatic palette. The overall tone is soft and impressionistic, focusing on movement and spontaneity.
